IN PHOTOS: Environmentalists from the Kalikasan People's Network for the Environment, environmentalists, and other civil society organizations are taking action to protest the widespread felling of trees for the 40.62-kilometer Southern Access Link Expressway (SALEX) project. The group will gather along Quirino Avenue, where they plan to form a human chain around the remaining trees—a symbolic stand against further ecological destruction. 

📸: Norman Cruz
